name: Connected and Disconnected Signed Pattern Triples
definition: On coordinates $a,b,c$ with rank target one, first choose $f_{ab}=f_{ac}=f_{bc}=00$. For the contrasting choice take $f_{ab}=00$, $f_{ac}=10$, and $f_{bc}=11$.
properties: For the all-zero choice the agreement graph is a triangle and the avoider is the four-word maximum class $\{111,110,101,011\}$. In the contrasting choice every pair disagrees on its common coordinate, the agreement graph is disconnected, and only $010,101$ survive. Thus one forbidden pattern per support does not by itself imply maximumity.
